content: BioWare, the legendary studio behind RPGs like Mass Effect, Dragon Age, and Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic, is shutting down, the company confirmed in a statement. Alongside the closure, Electronic Arts has chosen not to continue development on the next Mass Effect game that was in the works, according to an announcement sent to EA staff. The company is also laying off around 400 staffers, Bloomberg reports, including around 50 at BioWare. The changes follow EA being taken private by an investor group led by Saudi Arabia’s Public Investment Fund, Silver Lake, and Affinity Partners in a $55 billion deal that closed in August. Other major gaming companies have made sweeping changes this year as well, including Xbox’s “reset” that will include 3,200 cuts, Bungie’s “significant” layoffs, and Fortnite maker Epic Games laying off over 1,000 staff. “BioWare is a legendary studio that helped define the role-playing genre, and we do not take this decision lightly,” Cam Weber, EA president and chief studios officer, and David Tinson, EA president and COO, said in the announcement. Here is the full message that BioWare shared on social media: > For more than 30 years, BioWare has been more than a studio. It has been a home for storytellers, developers, and the players who brought our worlds to life. > Baldur’s Gate. Neverwinter Nights. Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic. Dragon Age. Mass Effect. Anthem. > Now, after more than three decades of shared adventures, BioWare is closing and early development on the next Mass Effect project is ending. > There is nothing easy about writing those words. Our focus right now is on our incredibly talented team who put their hearts into these games, and supporting one another through this transition. > What generations of BioWare built together is something to celebrate and remember. These games became so much more because you played them, debated your choices, fell in love with the characters, and made these worlds your own. > From all of us at BioWare, thank you for being the most meaningful part of our story. While the end of BioWare will shock many gamers who fondly remember its hits, the company hasn’t been as successful in recent years. 2017’s Mass Effect: Andromeda was widely seen as a misstep for that franchise, it took a big bet on live service games in 2019 with Anthem that didn’t pan out, and EA laid off some BioWare staff in 2025 after Dragon Age: The Veilguard missed sales expectations. Initially, the fate of Amazon’s Mass Effect TV series was unclear. Amazon MGM Studios spokesperson Nate Kirtman declined to comment. EA spokesperson Justin Higgs said he had “Nothing to share on that at this point.” But Wednesday evening, IGN reported that the show is still in development. In EA’s company-wide announcement, Weber and Tinson outlined several other projects in development and changes to EA’s roadmap. The executives say that Respawn and DICE will be collaborating on “a future project,” which Bloomberg says is “likely” a new Star Wars: Battlefront game. The company is still working Marvel’s Iron Man and a new Star Wars Jedi title. EA is making a “brand-new, social-first open-world experience” football game that it calls “Project Gridiron” and is also in pre-production on a new Fight Night boxing title (which was teased yesterday). For The Sims, the company is pausing development on “Project Lotus” and focusing on “Project Evergreen.” And for its live-service Skate, EA is “making changes to the studio” to “deliver on a very clear roadmap for our community.” Here is the full message from Weber and Tinson at Electronic Arts: > Hi Team, > First, thank you. > Through every major moment we’ve faced as a company, your commitment to creating awesome games and experiences for our players continues to be impressive. Together, we’ve built epic worlds and global communities that are part of the lives of hundreds of millions of people. > Today, we’re the number one publisher in Western HD gaming. That’s an extraordinary position to lead from, and one we should be proud of. Yet our industry is changing quickly. Players have more choices than ever for their time and attention, competition is intensifying, and some of our biggest opportunities for growth are beyond the markets, platforms, and business models where EA has traditionally been the strongest. > That’s why, over the past several months, we’ve taken a hard look at our business, how we operate, and what it will take to lead in this next era of interactive entertainment. We’ve challenged assumptions, confronted hard realities, imagined new possibilities, and made deliberate choices in order to deliver exceptional experiences for our players and to drive sustained growth. > We believe our best creative work happens when we’re clear about what matters most for our players and give our teams the freedom to move quickly. So, we’re concentrating our teams, technology, and investment behind these three strategic priorities. > * Deepen Our Core: Our greatest opportunity starts with our franchises and global communities that have made EA a leader in interactive entertainment. This is where we’ve had to make our hardest choices. Saying no to some things we’re passionate about allows us to focus our teams and resources so we give our biggest opportunities everything they need to succeed. * Expand Our Reach: The strength of our core business creates an enormous opportunity to reach more players across new platforms, markets, and business models. As one example, in regions as dynamic as Asia, success means building experiences that reflect local players, cultures, and expectations. * Transform Our Business: We believe we can use our experience building interactive entertainment, together with our relationships in sports, to create entirely new ways for fans to engage with the teams, athletes and sports they love. These will be disciplined investments that only scale when they demonstrate real potential. > These
chineseContent: BioWare 在一份声明中证实，该公司即将关闭，该公司是《质量效应》、《龙腾世纪》和《星球大战：旧共和国武士》等角色扮演游戏的传奇工作室。根据发给 EA 员工的公告，除了关闭之外，艺电还选择不再继续开发正在开发的下一款《质量效应》游戏。据彭博社报道，该公司还裁员约 400 名员工，其中 BioWare 约 50 名员工。这些变化是在 EA 被沙特阿拉伯公共投资基金、Silver Lake 和 Affinity Partners 牵头的投资集团以 550 亿美元的交易于 8 月完成私有化之后发生的。其他主要游戏公司今年也做出了彻底的改变，包括 Xbox 的“重置”，其中包括 3,200 名裁员，Bungie 的“重大”裁员，以及 Fortnite 制造商 Epic Games 裁员 1,000 多名员工。 “BioWare 是一家传奇工作室，帮助定义了角色扮演类型，我们不会轻易做出这个决定，”EA 总裁兼首席工作室官 Cam Weber 和 EA 总裁兼首席运营官 David Tinson 在公告中表示。以下是 BioWare 在社交媒体上分享的完整信息： > 30 多年来，BioWare 不仅仅是一家工作室。它一直是故事讲述者、开发者和让我们的世界变得栩栩如生的玩家的家。 > 博德之门。无冬之夜。星球大战：旧共和国武士。龙腾世纪.质量效应。国歌。 > 现在，经过三十多年的共同冒险，BioWare 即将关闭，下一个质量效应项目的早期开发也即将结束。 > 写这些话绝非易事。我们现在的重点是我们才华横溢的团队，他们全心投入这些游戏，并在这一转变过程中互相支持。 > BioWare 的哪几代产品
